info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Regions-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Regions API provides access to essential information on regions affected by weather alerts. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of geographical regions currently subject to weather warnings or advisories. It is particularly useful for developers building applications that require real-time weather monitoring and alerting features, such as emergency services, travel applications, and local government agencies. Users can leverage this information to enhance situational awareness and ensure timely responses to weather-related incidents.

get.summary: Retrieve alerts for a specific region.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch alerts associated with a particular region, providing users with critical information related to alerts in that geographical area.
